1. Begin by acquiring Oak Logs. Assuming you have access or means to obtain these raw materials, get 6 Oak Logs.
2. Convert these 6 Oak Logs into 4 Oak Planks each (6 Oak Logs -> 4 Oak Planks + 2 Oak Logs left).
3. Use the obtained 4 Oak Planks to craft the Oak Pressure Plate (4 Oak Planks -> 1 Oak Pressure Plate).

The exact sequence of steps is:

1. Craft Oak Planks: Use 6 Oak Logs to make 4 Oak Planks, leaving you with 2 Oak Logs.
   - Now you will have 4 Oak Planks.
   
2. Craft Oak Pressure Plate: Utilize these 4 Oak Planks to produce 1 Oak Pressure Plate.

So, the final sequence of commands (in plain English steps) to ensure you end up with 1 Oak Pressure Plate would be:

1. Obtain 6 Oak Logs.
2. Craft 4 Oak Planks from 6 Oak Logs (leaving 2 Oak Logs unused).
3. Craft 1 Oak Pressure Plate from 4 Oak Planks (which now consists of the 4 Oak Planks you had plus the 2 Oak Planks previously crafted from the initial 6 Oak Logs).

This way, you will have successfully completed the task of crafting the Oak Pressure Plate, adhering only to the recipes provided and the constraints on resource amounts.
